metadata.title: Retro Diner Portrait with Bold Sans-Serif Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male subject in a retro diner setting framed by massive, edge-to-edge sans-serif display text at the top and bottom.
triggerTerms: retro diner portrait with bold text

recipe.visualDefinition: A man with dark curly hair and orange-tinted sunglasses sits in a wide crouch on a white diner counter. He wears a vintage ringer tee and black trousers. The background features stainless steel diner equipment and red-tiled accents. Large, white, bold sans-serif text spans the top and bottom edges of the frame, with small national flag icons placed in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between two horizontal bands of heavy display text
Contrast between the warm, busy diner interior and the clean, flat white typography
Symmetry created by the subject's crouching pose and the stool placement
Visual connection between the orange sunglasses and the warm interior lighting
coreInvariants: Edge-to-edge bold sans-serif display text at top and bottom
Subject positioned on a horizontal counter surface
Retro diner interior with metallic and tiled textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, mid-ground, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and orange sunglasses, framed by the large top text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the body down to the counter, and ends at the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject, background details, and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral whites and metallic silvers from the diner and text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the trousers and boots.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange in the sunglasses and red in the diner tiles and stools.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright white text and the darker, saturated tones of the interior.
paletteRestrictions: Primary use of white for graphic elements

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or single-family weight variation for a cohesive, high-impact look.
graphicDevices: Circular badge/sticker element in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, modern geometric feel with excellent legibility at large scales.
Provides a slightly more vintage, editorial news feel.
Geometric and wide, matching the 'ISAAC LIKES' proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man with curly hair and orange sunglasses crouching on a white diner counter in a retro 1970s style diner. The background should include stainless steel appliances and red tiles. Leave clear space at the very top and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, white uppercase sans-serif text across the top edge and a slightly smaller line of white uppercase sans-serif text across the bottom edge. Place two small rectangular flag icons in the upper right area.

verificationChecks: Is the top text large enough to touch the top edge?
Is the subject centered and crouching?
Is the font a heavy, clean sans-serif?
Are the colors in the photo warm and vintage-toned?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the clothing
Do not replicate the specific face of the individual
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of the original wording

mustAchieve: High-contrast legibility of white text against the background
Authentic retro diner lighting and texture
avoid: Cluttered typography that obscures the face

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Ensure the orange sunglasses are a distinct focal point.
Verify the white text has no drop shadows or outlines.
Confirm the crouching pose feels natural and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Retro environment + Edge-to-edge bold sans-serif headers/footers = Editorial Impact.
